description: VBA project configurations analyzed by check_vba_calls.py. Each configuration is one VBA project that can exist in a real host; modules from different configurations are never combined.
untracked_components: Document modules (ThisWorkbook, worksheet modules) live only inside the Office packages and are not exported. Their procedures are not globally callable, so they cannot satisfy an unqualified call; calls made from them are not analyzed.

packaged-hosts.description: Components of both release packages: DATETIMEPICKER.vX.Y.Z.xlam and the demo .xlsm (production, demo builder and regression harness).

embedded-minimum.description: Smallest compilable embedded import documented in INSTALLATION.md: production source plus both demo modules, without the regression harness.

production-core.description: Production source alone. Documented as not compiling until #86 removes the dependency on demo modules; analyzed to measure that boundary, never gating.
